newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Boyfriend suspected of killing mother, daughters.
newsitem.headline: Boyfriend suspected of killing mother, daughters.

text.p: A mother and her three daughters were killed in eastern Belgium in what appeared to be an act of revenge by the jilted boyfriend of one of the girls, Belgian investigators said on Tuesday.

The four were found dead in their house in the hamlet of Bas-Oha late on Monday after neighbours alerted police when the husband, on a business trip in Spain, telephoned them to say that he had been unable to contact his wife.
All four victims had been shot in the back of the head, while the oldest daughter had also been shot through the chest with a crossbow.
Police found a scrawled message in the kitchen reading "Your daughter is driving me crazy", which they believed could point to the jilted boyfriend.

Investigating judge Ernest Hougardy said the ex-boyfriend was suspected. "He has disappeared from his home. Also, he had good reasons to be angry with the girl since she turned him down and was going out with another."
Police said they had been unable to locate the suspect.
